source: V3.2 requirements cross-checked against 数据字段说明.pdf
policy: No unlisted substitute field may be selected automatically.

decisions.reason: Delivered domestic tables expose a daily partition date but no record-level publish timestamp; ROUND 2 therefore enforces day-level Point-in-Time visibility with ds and separately filters physical event time where present.
The delivered placement table is not a planned distribution process table.
No formal actual distribution quantity is delivered.
No formal planned display date is delivered.
No formal actual display date is delivered.
The inventory-center table is a reconciliation snapshot, not transaction flow.
Domestic delivered tables do not provide a confirmed formal MOQ field.
Supplier history provides fulfillment proxies, not committed available capacity.
Formal first-order/reorder lead-time schedules are not delivered.
The delivered domestic sales table does not provide a formal promotion flag.
The first-arrival field is delivered. A versioned 28-day initial launch window is configured and may be overridden after category-level Train calibration.

Absence of an arrival row cannot distinguish a store that was not planned from a missing source row. The default empirical model records this limitation and lowers evidence confidence; a planned-distribution snapshot can later override it.
V3.2 defines these as versioned/backtested operating thresholds. The PDF and delivered field dictionary do not provide their business values.

The current Round 4 pool restores selected cohort SKUs for their post-launch windows; it is not a complete store-by-category restored history for the 90 days before the decision cutoff. Missing CategoryFit is therefore renormalized rather than fabricated.
The fields exist, but a formal store execution rate needs a versioned representative SKU/time universe. The bounded Round 4 pool is not asserted to be complete.
Only open/closed store eligibility can currently be enforced. V3.2 hard constraints for reachability, bans and theme/category qualification require additional business inputs.
Observed comparable curves and category lifecycle priors can be calculated, but the V3.2 insufficient-sample random-effects model must be fitted and validated on the full Train cohort.
No confirmed future event calendar is delivered. V3.2 permits H=1 when no confirmed schedule applies; output records this status explicitly.
